create_coco_evaluator: create a CocoEvaluator instance for distributed COCO evaluation with bbox and segmentation metrics
run_coco_evaluation: run online COCO evaluation on model predictions by calling update with postprocessed results per image
summarize_coco_metrics: summarize accumulated COCO evaluation results into AP and AR statistics across IoU thresholds and area ranges
prepare_segmentation_predictions: prepare model predictions into COCO segmentation format with RLE-encoded masks and area values
synchronize_distributed_eval: synchronize COCO evaluation state across distributed processes and gather predictions via filesystem or collective ops
